notes: v6.1.1 - LIVE CLIPPING HOTFIX. Some live streams (many YouTube lives) offer only separate video and audio formats, and v6.1 asked for a combined format only, so Live Clipping could not start on them. The resolver now walks a chain of format choices until one matches and records separate video+audio picks as two inputs; when a live truly cannot start, the panel now says why in one plain line - the live has not started yet, it has already ended, or the video is private / needs a sign-in. Everything else is exactly v6.1. Your settings, keys and PRO unlock carry over.
